TZA.note: Payment and passport services are planned on the ID but no authentication service is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA director general James Kaji said birth certificates and some RITA functions are intended to move onto the national ID, so that many civil services sit with NIDA.

Home Affairs minister Patrobas Katambi reported 27,520,835 people registered with NIDA and 23,515,667 issued a National Identification Number, which is 39% and 33% of the 70.5 million population (shares computed from the population held; figures as corrected in the record's summary, the body text differing).

TZA.note: The Prime Minister ordered enrolment of young children, but no number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: Minister Katambi said NIDA now serves 156 offices, with machines and equipment that print ID cards electronically.

The Prime Minister directed the Home Affairs minister and NIDA to connect social and economic institutions to the ID system, and NIDA said health insurance and a Jamii Namba holding all social services are to be built on it.
Minister Katambi said 23,515,667 people have been issued a National Identification Number and 21,526,635 cards have been produced, with 2,027,103 finished cards uncollected.
